_about: A real K1C (firmware 1.3.5.22) running out of filament, as it streamed it on 2026-10-26: the filament was pulled from the runout sensor mid-print. The printer pauses (state 5), and 27 ms later reports materialStatus 1 and materialDetector1 1; the print is then cancelled (state 7, then 4) with the filament still out; it is reloaded (feedState 1, then 2), and both flags return to 0. The first line is the merged state the printer had sent before the window (marked merged_state). One line per frame, in order; t is seconds since the first frame. Heartbeats, the print history (historyList) and the file listing (retGcodeFileInfo2) removed, hostname anonymised; values otherwise as received, numbers-as-strings included.
